deployment_config.architecture: same-origin: this engine serves the Next.js static export AND /api/* on $PORT (no proxy, no CORS, no client-side keys)
deployment_config.authority: ENGINE_COMMIT + PORTFOLIO_COMMIT + this deployment configuration = the reproducible deployed product

pins.portfolio_release: R387-3D-QUALITY-EDITION (ENGINE_RELEASE_REGISTRY.json entry; CANONICAL_RELEASE_MANIFEST.json pins 924 buyer-surface files)
pins.portfolio_acquisition: toscanini/start.sh fetches EXACTLY this sha at container start (git fetch --depth 1 <sha>; token-safe GIT_ASKPASS). A moving branch NEVER determines buyer-package contents.
pins.engine_commit: set by the deploy step: the Render env var ENGINE_COMMIT is set to the exact sha the deploy was triggered with, at deploy time. Verification is LIVE: GET /api/health reports engine_commit, engine_commit_source, and (when the build context carried .git) the image-baked commit for cross-check. A manifest cannot contain its own commit (Art. XXXIX section 2 pattern).

secrets: GITHUB_TOKEN (private-repo acquisition + runtime-state pushes; supplied via GIT_ASKPASS, never in URLs/argv/image/logs)

transport.note: explicit operator overrides (R375 mechanism) — recorded in every call-site ledger and in candidate provenance; NVIDIA_MODEL is the registry's existing per-provider model override. Measured 2026-09-02 from the deployment source network: 3 consecutive OK completions, 1.5-3.1 s, FIELD-line compliant.

persistence.note: minimum durable layer: session/job metadata, evidence references, key run artifacts, package zips — committed to the private engine repo's runtime-state branch via the existing GITHUB_TOKEN. Large regenerable intermediates stay ephemeral.

deploy_procedure: 1. Repo clean and pushed; CI green on the exact commit (Art. XXIII/XXVI).
2. autoDeploy OFF on the Render service — a moving main never silently redeploys.
3. Set ENGINE_COMMIT + PORTFOLIO_COMMIT + transport + persistence env vars on the service.
4. Trigger the deploy pinned to the exact commit (Render deploy API, commit id).
5. Verify: GET /api/health -> engine_commit matches, portfolio_commit matches the pin (portfolio_pin_match=true), llm_transport_ready=true (real live completion), discovery_ready=true.
6. Run a FRESH discovery through the public URL (never a replayed fixture).

security.secrets_scope: server-side only; adversarial leak scan (scripts/r392_readiness_tests.py) covers HTML, JS bundle, API responses, logs, and the Docker build context
